title: Before God lifts you…
paragraphs:
Before God lifts you…
what if He’s building the strength to carry it?

Some people want elevation.
Others are willing to kneel first.

The world rewards noise.
God rewards posture.

We all want the “suddenly.”
But 1 Peter 5 says the order is different.

Lower yourself.
Trust His timing.
Then He lifts you.

Promotion without formation breaks people.
Formation first builds capacity.
